no_building_admin: No floor plan yet. Draw your first floor in the editor.
phone_hint: Drawing works best on a PC or tablet – on a phone you can look around and control your home.
save_failed_detail: Saving failed: {error}. Your changes are kept in this browser.
needs_restart: A new version of Casa 3D ({frontend}) is installed, but Home Assistant still runs {version}. Please restart Home Assistant – until then saving may fail.
needs_reload: This page still shows Casa 3D {frontend}, Home Assistant already has {backend}. Please reload the page; in the companion app: Settings → Companion app → Reset frontend cache.
needs_restart_old: A new version of Casa 3D is installed, but Home Assistant still runs an older one. Please restart Home Assistant – until then saving fails.
area_rooms_hint: Adds a room (4 × 3 m) for each area of this floor – then drag it into place and adjust the corners
floor_shift_hint: Moves every room, furniture item, device, outdoor area, free wall and the background image of this floor by X and Z. Roof sections and cables stay.
delete_floor_confirm: Delete floor “{name}” with all its rooms?
floor_none_hint: Add your first floor at the top with "Floor" → "Add floor".
fit_hint: Bring the whole floor plan of the floor into view (with the garden when outside)
tech_open_hint: Then tap the wall in the plan your equipment hangs on.
tech_step_feed: Tap "{name}" on the left, then the spot on the wall where the line comes in (right at the bottom: out of the floor).
tech_step_devices: Tap the filter pump and the sand filter on the left – they stand at the wall. The heat pump and dosing unit if you have them.
tech_step_line: Draw a line: from "{a}" to "{b}". Just press on the one and drag to the other.
tech_step_loose: A pipe still ends loose – draw it on to a device or a line, or delete it (✋ Select).
tech_step_drawing: Drag on or tap point by point – the line ends on a device, a line or a pipe.
tech_step_fit: Tap the pipe the valve (sight glass) goes into – it lights up orange.
tech_mode_hint: Draw the technical room on this wall: bring the pool's lines in, put the devices up, draw the pipes
pool_delete_confirm: Delete the pool with all {n} pipes?
tech_erase_hint: Tap a pipe, ball valve, sight glass or hole – it is removed. Drew it wrong? Undo helps too.
tech_hint: Draw a line: tap a device, a line or a pipe and drag to the next one (or tap point by point). Dragged onto a pipe it makes a T-piece. Casa 3D works out which way the water runs and which connection of a device it takes.
tech_no_ports: First put the skimmer, bottom drain and inlets at the pool with the pool tool.
tech_feed_place: Tap where the line comes into the room – right at the bottom: out of the floor, higher up: through the wall.
tech_start: Tap a device or a line and draw a line.
pool_depth_hint: Basin depth: from the rim down to the floor. A 1.50 m deep pool standing 20 cm out of the lawn: depth 1.50, rim 0.20. The water stands 15 cm below the rim.
pool_depth_ground: The depth shows in 3D once the pool lies in a lawn, terrace or other area – without ground around it the basin would show from outside.
pool_port_depth_hint: How far below the water line (m): inlets usually 0.30, the skimmer at the water line
pool_valve_toggle: Tap to switch – the way the valve really stands
block_some_fixed: 🔒 A part of it is fixed – the block moves once all parts are released.
wv_gap_hint: Tap a free spot on the wall: what fits there appears here.
block_hint: A click selects the whole block, dragging moves it. One part on its own: double-tap it or pick its name below.
multi_hint: Shift + click adds or removes items, Shift + drag over empty ground draws a frame. Move, turn or copy them together, or join them into a block.
multi_mode: Select several (a tap adds, a drag draws a frame)
block_delete_fixed: Delete {n} items? Some of them are fixed.
pkg_hint: Furniture goes against the room's walls; lamps link to the area's lights. Adjust single items afterwards – Ctrl+Z takes it all back.
pkg_done: {n} items placed – Ctrl+Z takes it back.
pkg_kitchen_row_desc: Row on the back wall with fridge, oven, sink, dishwasher and stove, wall cabinet, dining table with pendant
pkg_kitchen_l_desc: Rows at the back and left, kitchen island with bar stools
pkg_bath_desc: Washbasin, WC, bathtub, washing machine, downlight
pkg_bedroom_desc: Double bed with two nightstands, wardrobe, chest of drawers, ceiling light
pkg_living_desc: TV board, sofa, coffee table, rug, armchair, shelf, floor lamp, plant
pkg_dining_desc: Table with four chairs, sideboard, pendant
pkg_office_desc: Desk with office chair, two shelves, ceiling light
spots_hint: All lamps follow the chosen light (e.g. spots on one dimmer). Afterwards each can be moved and linked to another light like any furniture.
backup_none: None yet. While editing, a restore point is kept at most every 10 minutes.
backup_restore_confirm: Restore the state of {time}? The current state is kept as a restore point.
backup_export_share_hint: Without areas, devices, sensors and images – for passing on to others.
backup_import_confirm: Replace the whole plan with the file? The current state is kept as a restore point.
backup_import_error: The file is no Casa 3D plan ({error}).
backup_hint: Background images are not part of the file.
backup_other_hint: A floor plan from Sweet Home 3D, an iPhone scan, CAD (DXF), Blender/SketchUp or a robot vacuum map?
backup_full_hint: One file with the plan, every background and screen picture and the installed packs. On restore every pack is checked again; the licence key is not included.
backup_full_confirm: Replace the plan, the pictures and the packs with the backup? The current state stays as a restore point.
backup_full_not_backup: This is not a full Casa 3D backup.
backup_full_skipped: Skipped (not verifiable or bound to another installation): {packs}.
device_confirm_hint: A tap in 3D, the quick menu and the room panel ask first. A double tap on the room leaves this device out.
cover_confirm_hint: Open, close and positions ask first in the quick menu and the room panel, and a swipe on the marker no longer moves the blind (it turns the view instead). Stop never asks.
split_handle_hint: Drag: width of the plan and the 3D view
background_edit_hint: While the mode is on: dragging the picture moves it, the handle at the bottom right scales it. Fit the picture to the scale first, then turn it.
hint_select: Tap a room to select · drag corners · “+” on an edge inserts a corner · arrow keys nudge · Del deletes · Ctrl+Z
hint_polygon: Place corners · tap the first corner or press Enter to close · Esc cancels
overlap_warning: Rooms overlap – walls there are incomplete.
read_only: Only administrators can edit the floor plan.
roof_keep_hint: The roof stays on the house while zooming in instead of lifting and fading out
devices_none_area: Link the room to an area and its devices appear here.
devices_none: The area has no suitable devices.
devices_place_all_confirm: Put {n} devices into the room at once? (Ctrl+Z or “Undo” takes them all back in one step.)
panel_unhide: Show in the room panel again
panel_state_hide: Hide the state in the room panel (e.g. a cover that only reports "unknown")
panel_state_show: Show the state in the room panel again
devices_hint: Placed devices appear in 3D. Drag them in the plan to move them.
camera_aim_hint: In the plan the wedge shows where the camera looks. The handle at its tip turns the camera and sets its reach. In 3D the wedge ends at the first wall.
camera_detect_found: Detection (camera cockpit): {n} sensors found on the device – {kinds}. When one reports something, a pin stands in front of the camera in the 3D view; the camera wall (Cameras switch at the bottom of the 3D view) shows every live picture.
camera_detect_none: Detection (camera cockpit): the camera's device has no motion or detection sensors. Pins appear as soon as the integration provides some (Frigate, UniFi Protect, Reolink …).
camera_cone: Show the field of view in 3D
camera_detect_pins_hint: Off: a detection shows no symbols over the camera, only the field of view turns red – calmer on a wall tablet.
central: Central: all lights, blinds and favourites
central_no_favorites: No favourites yet. Set scenes, scripts and switches in the editor under "Favourites".
card_central_hint: All lights and blinds of the floor or the house and the favourites from the editor.
favorites_hint: Scenes, scripts, automations, buttons and switches for the central menu (star) of the 3D view – party, presence simulation, shading, watering.
background_handles_hint: The picture now has handles like a piece of furniture: drag moves it, the lower right corner scales it, the round handle on top turns it (Shift for 15° steps). When it fits, tap "Done" – then it stays put.
background_fixed_hint: The picture stays put, you can draw over it. To adjust it, tap "Move, scale and turn".
bg_level_first: Tap the start of a wall in the picture that should run straight (horizontal or vertical).
bg_level_second: Now tap the end of that wall – the picture turns to fit.
bg_ruler_first: Tap the start of a stretch of known length in the picture – e.g. a dimensioned wall.
bg_ruler_second: Now tap the end of the stretch.
bg_ruler_length_hint: Measured in the plan: {m}. Enter the real length and the picture is scaled to fit.
thumbs_fold: Fold the floor pictures into buttons
room_start_view_hint: When you tap the room in 3D, the camera flies to exactly the view the 3D pane on the right shows now – angle, zoom and framing. Turn on 3D beside first, turn and zoom in on the room, then tap.
room_start_view_reset: Remove the room's start view (from above again)
room_start_view_need_pane: Turn on "3D beside" first, then turn and zoom the room the way it should open.
floor_start_view_hint: This floor opens in 3D the way the 3D pane on the right stands right now – e.g. the ground floor from the front and the upper floor from the back. Turn on 3D beside first, turn it, then tap.
floor_start_view_reset: Remove the floor's start view (like the house again)
floor_start_view_need_pane: Turn on "3D beside" first and turn the floor the way it should open.
glow_scale_hint: How strongly the lamp glows in 3D: below 100 % tones down bright LED strips so the room does not burn out; above 100 % makes a weak lamp glow more. Switches nothing in Home Assistant.
vehicle_to_spot_hint: A vehicle as plain furniture always stands there. As a parking spot it appears only while a sensor reports the car, and that is where Car Pro is set up (charge, range, lock, climate).
as_furniture_hint: Replaces the pin by a furniture item in the same place, linked to this device – a speaker for a media player, a lamp for a light. Ctrl+Z takes it back.
as_device_hint: Replaces the furniture by the plain pin of its device in the same place.
presets_hint: Shown in every speaker's quick menu under "Play", next to the player's sources. For an Echo (Alexa Media Player): type SPOTIFY, AMAZON_MUSIC or TUNEIN and as content what you would say ("Rock Antenne"). For Sonos, Music Assistant and others: type music or url with a stream address or a URI.
preset_type_hint: media_content_type of play_media, e.g. music, url, playlist, SPOTIFY, AMAZON_MUSIC, TUNEIN
preset_content_hint: media_content_id: stream URL, URI (spotify:playlist:…) or, for Alexa, a search phrase
own_buttons_hint: Shown in the central menu (star) below the favourites: open a dashboard path, show an entity's details, call a service, or open a browser_mod popup with your own card.
own_data_hint: For a service its data, for fire-dom-event the event's content, e.g. {"browser_mod": {"service": "browser_mod.popup", "data": {…}}}.
panel_no_area: This room is not linked to an area. You can link it in the editor.
panel_empty: No devices of this room are in the plan. In the editor, place devices or pick them for the room panel with ☆.
walk_hint: Drag: look around · tap the floor: walk there · W A S D / arrow keys or the stick: walk · Esc: end
hint_joint_place: T- or Y-piece: tap the plan – tapped on a pipe, it is put into the pipe
wall_run_place: Tap the wall where it goes
pool_holes_hint: Holes in walls and the floor are set in the wall view (side bar).
conn_and: And to (a second end, with a T-piece before)
conn_hint: The way is laid by itself – inside from connection to connection, outside at right angles under the ground. Fine-tune it in the wall view and the plan.
wall_run_start: Pipe: start at a device, on a pipe (T-piece) or on the wall
wall_run_next: Set more points – it ends at a device or on a pipe; double click or Enter finishes
wall_run_fit: Tap the pipe where it goes
wall_run_tip: Drag points · double click removes · tap a ball valve: open/closed
wall_view_turn: Turn by 45° – at the wall it moves back into the room
wall_view_lift: Drag up or down: height above the floor
wall_zoom_hint: Zoom: mouse wheel or two fingers
wall_view_hint_3d: Tap a piece and drag it on the floor · mouse wheel or two fingers: closer or further away · middle or right mouse button (two fingers on a tablet): look around · type distances and height below · arrows left and right: to the next wall
wall_view_room: See this room's walls from the front
hint_wall_pick: Wall view: click into the room (or near a wall)
wall_view_open: See the wall from the front: move the furniture on it along the wall and up or down
wall_view_hint: Drag to move along the wall and – for hanging pieces – up or down · arrow keys 1 cm, with Shift 10 cm · edges snap to the wall's ends, doors, windows and other furniture (Alt: free) · double-click opens the piece in the plan
wall_view_empty: Nothing at this wall yet – furniture standing with its back to the wall or hanging on it shows here.
hold_hint: Tap toggles · long press opens details
panel_unpin: Don't show in the room panel
devices_panel_hint: The room panel shows the devices in the plan. ☆ adds a device to the room panel without placing it.
card_fill_hint: Works best in a dashboard view of the type “Panel (single card)” – the card then takes all the space.
card_floor_thumbs_hint: Small pictures of the floors at the side – tap one to switch
card_floor_thumbs_hint_start: The chosen floor is then where the card starts – the pictures at the side switch to the others
card_pro_hint: Motion trail and weather are Pro add-ons: without the matching add-on these switches have no effect.
card_idle_return: Back to the start view after
card_idle_hint: After the wait the card closes the room and shows the start view again.
card_idle_orbit_hint: After the return the view turns slowly until someone touches the tablet
card_dashboard_hint: A button at the top right of the card opens the dashboard or view with this path, e.g. /lovelace/home or /dashboard-house/0. Without a label it shows ⌂.
card_alerts_hint: Smoke, gas, CO, water, alarm panel and windows open in the rain: the room pulses, a note appears at the top
card_alert_jump: Jump to the room of a new warning
card_alert_jump_hint: The view switches to the floor and room of the warning by itself
director_hint: A screen shows by itself what happens in the house: the doorbell rings – the view flies to the front door and looks through its camera. Every event is off until you switch it on.
director_here_hint: Only for this browser, e.g. the wall tablet. On a dashboard card you switch the live director on in the card settings.
director_doorbell: Doorbell rings: fly to the door and look through the camera
director_no_doorbell: No doorbell found. Choose your doorbell's event or binary sensor entity.
director_alerts: New warning (smoke, water, alarm, window in the rain …)
director_back_hint: Then the view goes back to where it was – unless someone touched the screen meanwhile. Someone using the tablet is only interrupted by the doorbell and by warnings. The doorbell stays twice as long.
voice_hint: A microphone button at the bottom left of the 3D view: tap it and speak. “Show the living room”, “upper floor” or “the whole house” shows the place; anything else (“turn on the hall light”) goes to Home Assistant's Assist.
voice_needs: Needs https, the microphone allowed (in Fully Kiosk: Web Content Settings → microphone access) and an Assist pipeline with speech to text. On a dashboard card you switch the button on in the card settings.
voice_silent: The microphone gives only silence. Usually another app holds it – in Fully Kiosk switch off the acoustic motion detection (Motion Detection → Acoustic Detection) and reload.
voice_no_pipeline: No speech to text set up in Assist (Settings → Voice assistants).
voice_denied: Microphone not allowed – only over https and with the permission in the browser or in Fully Kiosk.
card_voice_hint: “Show the living room” shows the room, other sentences go to Assist. Needs https and an allowed microphone
director_mic_hint: Checks https, the microphone and Assist's speech to text on this device and shows which room a sentence would open. Nothing is switched.
card_director_hint: The card shows by itself what happens. Which events, you choose in the editor under “Live director”.
card_scenes_hint: Scenes and scripts of the area as buttons under the 3D view while a room is selected
card_camera_wall_hint: A button at the bottom of the card opens the camera wall with every live picture (Pro: camera cockpit).
card_motion_trail_hint: Where motion was reported in the last 30 minutes, with times (motion, presence and camera sensors)
camera_wall_hint: Camera wall: every live picture at once; a tap shows one picture big, a red frame shows motion
rain_warning: Warning: window open while it rains
rain_entity: Rain from your own weather station
rain_entity_hint: A rain sensor (on = rain) or a rain rate (mm/h) of your weather station says whether it rains at the house – for the rain warning and the rain in 3D. Without one the weather entity decides.
rain_ignore_hint: This window may stay open in the rain (under a canopy, say): no rain warning for this window, all others still warn.
outage_entity_hint: An entity that reports a power outage: a grid sensor (binary_sensor of class power – "off" means no power), a UPS ("on battery"), a mains voltage below 100 V or a helper of your own that is "on" during an outage. A warning then shows, and the grid connection is crossed out.
sun_patches_hint: With north set, the sunlight from sun.sun falls through the windows as bright patches on the floor. Untick it to keep the floor free of sun patches.
weather_effect_clouds: Clouds dim the sky and the sun
weather_effect_sky: Sun and moon in the sky
weather_entity_hint: The weather entity provides rain, snow, fog and clouds for the 3D view; automatic takes the first one.
weather_hint: Weather outside: rain, snow, fog and clouds from the weather entity, sun and moon from sun.sun
card_weather_hint: Rain, snow, fog and clouds from the first weather entity (weather_entity picks another); only the clouds on the tablet level
trail_hint: Motion trail: where motion was reported in the last 30 minutes, with times
alert_names_hint: On: "Kitchen · Smoke: Kitchen smoke detector". Off: just "Kitchen · Smoke" – shorter on a wall tablet. Without a room the device name stays.
import_error_not_plan: The file is no Casa 3D plan.
card_controls_hint: Tall walls/cut, floors apart and temperature, humidity, CO₂ to switch
controls_hide: Hide the controls – only the 3D view remains
nav_wrap: Wrap the bar: every floor and room on several lines
card_ghost_hint: Fun pack Halloween: the ghost floats through this card's house too (e.g. switch it off on the wall tablet)
card_pets_hint: Fun pack Pets: show the animals set up in this card (e.g. switch them off on the wall tablet)
news_pets_title: New: pets – a present for you
news_pets_text: A cat, a dog or a rabbit lives in your 3D house, walks through the rooms, lies down on the sofa and even takes the stairs – and fish swim in the aquarium. The fun pack is free with every customer account.
gift_title: 🎁 Two presents for you: Halloween and pets
gift_text: The fun packs Halloween (pumpkins, bats, a witch's cauldron and a ghost that floats through the house) and Pets (a cat, a dog and a rabbit walking through your house) are free in your customer account. Install them with one click under Extensions.
gift_text_free: Pumpkins, bats and a ghost that floats through the house – plus a cat, a dog and a rabbit living in your 3D house. Both fun packs are free with a customer account: create the account, confirm your e-mail, paste the key from the mail under Extensions → Shop connection. New packs then show up right here.
card_controls_hidden_hint: Only the 3D view; an eye at the bottom left brings bars, values and switches back
card_fullscreen_button_hint: Hides the dashboard around the card (e.g. on a wall tablet)
card_floor_house: Whole house (tap a floor to open it)
card_quality_hint: “Tablet” is the lightest setting – ideal for Fire tablets and other wall tablets.
holos_hint: Show or hide the holograms of the plant and the devices
card_energy: Show energy values at the top (Energy Pro)
card_room_panel_hint: The room's lights, blinds and cameras in a side panel
card_explode: Pull floors apart in the house view
card_roof_hint: Off: the house shows without its roof, as if it had none – the rooms lie open (solar fields on the roof go with it)
room_order_up: Move the room up (earlier in the room bar)
room_order_down: Move the room down (later in the room bar)
card_roof_fade: Fade the roof out while zooming in
card_roof_fade_hint: Off: the roof stays on the house even when the camera comes close.
card_stats_hint: To check how smoothly the card runs on the device
packs_hint: Only packs signed by the publisher can be imported.
lib_badge_light: Lamp: links to a light and switches in 3D
lib_badge_electric: Electric: links to an entity and a power sensor (switching, pictures, consumption)
lib_badge_hint: Items with a symbol link to entities: lamps switch, screens show pictures, appliances show their consumption.
pack_error_wrong_instance: This pack is signed for another Home Assistant installation. The shop account can deliver it for this one.
pro_feature_camera_cockpit: Camera cockpit: look through the camera, motion trail, camera wall and detection pins (person, vehicle, animal)
offers_loyalty: Your loyalty discount: {percent} % on every further pack and Pro add-on
pack_updated_added: {name} was updated to release {release}: {n} new items – have a look in the library!
fun_intro: Free extras just for fun – for everyone with a customer account. With a connected key they wait among your packs above to install; switch them on and off here.
fun_in_account: Free in your customer account – install it among your packs above.
fun_register_steps: Free with a customer account: create the account, confirm your e-mail, paste the key from the mail under Shop connection.
fun_feature_pets: A cat, a dog or a rabbit lives in your 3D house: it walks through the rooms, lies down on the sofa, the bed or the rug and sleeps at night.
fun_feature_halloween: Pumpkins that glow with a light, a cobweb, bats, gravestones, a skeleton, a witch's cauldron and candles – and a ghost that floats through the house now and then.
halloween_deco_hint: The decorations are in the editor's furniture library under "Fun pack: Halloween". Pumpkin, cauldron and candles glow with a linked light.
nl_text: Subscribe to the Casa 3D newsletter and get the taster packs living room, kitchen, bedroom and bathroom for free – they appear here by themselves once you confirm. The newsletter brings new versions, new furniture and offers. Unsubscribe at any time.
nl_after: Thank you! Please confirm the mail that is on its way. The packs then appear here – at the next daily check at the latest, at once with “{button}”.
pro_feature_weather: Weather outside: rain, snow, clouds, sun and moon
pro_feature_screens: Live screens: the media player's app colour and artwork, picture rules, camera live pictures on screens
pro_feature_energy_pro: Energy Pro: power-flow lines through the house, living solar modules, glass holograms for the plant and for devices, today's gas and water use – heat follows as an update
pro_feature_sound: Sound & Cinema: speakers show cover, title and volume as a glass card, sound rings around playing speakers, multiroom groups as lines, a quick menu with play, pause, track change and volume
pro_feature_auto_pro: Car Pro: the car in its parking spot shows charge, range, charging, lock and climate from its integration – a light band in the charge colour, a pin with percent and kilometres, a quick menu with lock, climate and charging, "away" with its location
pro_feature_pool: Pool Pro: the water glows in the colour of the pool light and moves while the filter pump runs; a glass card shows water temperature, heat pump with target temperature, filter pump, light, pH and chlorine/redox with a traffic light; the cover slides over the water; warnings for pH, chlorine and frost
pool_teaser: With Pool Pro your pool comes alive: the water glows in the colour of the pool light and moves while the filter pump runs. A glass card shows water temperature, heat pump, pH and chlorine – with buttons for target temperature, pump, light and cover.
pool_pro_hint: Empty fields are found by name (an entity with "pool" in its name), "None" switches a role off. The heat pump may be a climate or water heater entity (then the target temperature can be set) or a switch; the filter pump a switch or a power sensor.
pool_activate: Turn on Pool Pro for this pool
hint_pool: Choose a shape and draw the pool · tap a pool to select it
hint_pool_tech: Choose a shape and draw the pool · tap a pool to select it · ports, devices and pipes on the right
hint_pipe_start: Pipe: tap the start (port or device)
hint_pipe_pool: Pipe: first tap the pool the pipes belong to
hint_pipe_next: Tap corners, then the end (port or device) · Esc cancels
pool_tool_empty: No pool on this floor yet: choose the shape above and draw the pool.
pool_ports_hint: Skimmer and inlets sit on the rim, the bottom drain in the pool; the waste drain takes the backwash water. Move them in the plan.
pool_pipe_draw_hint: Pipes connect ports and devices in the flow direction: from the skimmer to the pump, on to the filter, through the heat pump or the bypass to the inlets. At a split the water goes through the heat pump while it is on, else through the bypass; a closed ball valve stops it. Tap a ball valve in the plan to open or close it.
pool_pipes_pro: With Pool Pro the water flows visibly through the pipes – blue, warm after the heat pump.
pool_above_hint: A pool standing on the ground instead of let into it: a wall all around, the water just below the rim.
pro_feature_time_travel: Time travel: a time slider replays up to 7 days in the house – lights, doors, windows, blinds, motion, heating, weather and the sun, with event markers. View only, nothing is switched
tt_hint: Replay up to 7 days in the house (view only, nothing is switched)
tt_no_recorder: Without Home Assistant's recorder there is no history.
tt_restart: Please restart Home Assistant – only then does it know time travel.
tt_locked: Time travel is a Pro add-on.
tt_readonly: Time travel: view only – nothing is switched
card_time_travel_hint: A button at the bottom of the card replays the last hours and days (Pro: time travel).
auto_pro_teaser: With Car Pro the vehicle here shows charge, range, charging, lock and climate from its integration (Tesla, VW, BMW, Hyundai/Kia, Renault, Smart, Polestar …): a light band in the charge colour, a pin with percent and kilometres, a quick menu with lock, climate and charging, and "away" with its location when it is out.
car_hint: One entity of the car is enough: Casa 3D finds the others on the same device in Home Assistant (charge, range, charging, cable, lock, climate, location). What it does not find you choose here; "None" switches a role off.
car_no_controls: No switchable entities found on the car (lock, climate, charge switch).
pro_locked: This feature is a Pro add-on. After the purchase it appears under Extensions › Shop connection and installs from there.
pack_remove_confirm: Remove the pack “{name}”? Its furniture stays in the plan as plain boxes.
pack_error_bad_signature: The pack was changed or its signature is invalid.
pack_error_unknown_publisher: This pack is not from a known publisher.
pack_error_not_a_pack: This is not a furniture pack file.
hint_furniture: Tap a room, then pick an item on the right · drag items, resize them by their corners
furniture_into: New items go into the middle of “{room}”.
furniture_pick_room: Tip: tap a room first – new items then land in its middle.
flows_hint: Show or hide glowing lines from the meter to the consumers
chk_hint: What energy and Energy Pro need. Tap a row to jump there.
chk_solar_add: Put a solar field on the roof
chk_battery: Home battery with power and charge
chk_battery_sensor: Home battery: power or charge missing
energy_sign_grid: Exporting right now although there is no PV power: the grid sensor probably counts the other way round.
energy_sign_battery: The battery charges without sun and without grid import: its sensor probably counts the other way round.
energy_pro_active_hint: Cables, living modules and the hologram are running. Gas, water and heat come as updates of this pack.
help_hint: Please report problems as a GitHub issue and wishes as a discussion – nothing gets lost, and everyone sees the state.
furn_mirror_hint: Swap left and right – the L-sofa the other way round, the cabinet with its door on the other side, the kitchen run mirrored.
cables_hint: Dashed: the cable finds its own way. Grab it in the plan or pick it here and press “Lay by hand”: it then runs solid over your points at the set height, e.g. along the facade outside or under the ceiling, and several cables can run side by side.
cable_points_hint: Drag the points in the plan. A click on the cable adds a point, a double click on a point removes it.
cable_other_floor: This cable is laid on the floor {floor}: switch there to drag its points.
holo_settings_hint: The hologram hangs on a solar field or floats free at a point in the plan; it keeps its size in the world and shrinks as you zoom out. Every further plant gets a card of its own over its field.
holo_device_house: Device cards in the house view too
holo_device_house_hint: Off: the cards over devices only show when their floor is open.
holo_plant_floor: House balance and plant cards in floor views too
units_hint: How the editor shows and reads lengths. Automatic follows Home Assistant's unit system. The plan always stores metres – type feet and inches as 8' 2", 98in or 8.2ft.
room_area_net_hint: Net: without the walls reaching into the room – shared interior walls stand half in the room, free walls and the gap behind a wall built in front of another do not count.
room_ceiling_hint: Empty = the floor height. With a height of its own the room's walls end there (unless a neighbouring room is taller), and ceiling lamps hang from that ceiling – e.g. 2.5 m in a living room beside a 5 m garage.
holo_plant_floor_hint: On: the cards stay visible when a floor is open – on the floor of their solar field (fields on the roof: the top floor, in the garden: the lowest).
holo_device_room: Device cards in an opened room
holo_device_room_hint: On: when you open a room, the cards of the devices in that room show (only that room's).
holo_mirror_hint: Looking from the back of the solar field, the cards show their back – mirrored like a pane of glass. Off: they stay readable from everywhere.
holo_place_free: Free in the plan (drag the ◈ handle)
holo_free_hint: A handle ◈ stands in the plan – drag it to where the hologram should float (beside the house too, say over the terrace). The card faces away from the house.
holo_no_field: No solar field in the plan yet: the hologram floats beside the house.
furn_plant_card_hint: Energy Pro: every plant (an inverter with fields of its own) gets a glass card over its field – power, day curve, battery. Switch it off for this plant here.
hint_opening: Tap a wall to add a door or window – choose its kind on the right afterwards
sidelight_hinge_hint: The sidelight sits opposite the hinge otherwise; ticked, it sits next to the hinges.
flip_swing_hint: The door swings into the room or to the other side
hint_measure: Tap the starting point, then type the wall lengths with their direction on the right
measure_start: Tap the starting point in the plan, e.g. a room corner.
measure_from: Start at {x} / {z} m – tapping moves the start.
measure_gap: Gap to the start: {gap} m (joined when closing)
measure_hint: Tip: type a length and press an arrow key. With measured inside dimensions, use “Close gaps” afterwards.
hint_outdoor: Drag to draw an outdoor area (lawn, terrace, pool …)
hint_outdoor_free: Place the corners of the outdoor area · tap the first corner or press Enter to close · Esc cancels
outdoor_draw_type_hint: What you draw next: lawn, terrace, path, pool … The type can still be changed in the form afterwards.
outdoor_outline_hint: Unticked, the area draws no glowing line along its edge – for large plots made of several lawns.
outdoor_hint: Outdoor lights (path light, garden spot, outdoor wall light) light all outdoor areas and the facade.
outdoor_open_hint: The edge from the last point back to the first is not drawn – a fence or pergola leaning against the house.
outdoor_cut: Cut out of the areas beneath
outdoor_area_hint: With an area the surface acts like a room: a tap in 3D opens it with the area's devices, it is in the room bar and wears its name.
outdoor_cut_hint: Every area drawn before this one that contains it whole gets a hole here – a pond or a wild patch in the lawn.
outdoor_slope_hint: Height difference from the high edge to the low edge; the high edge sits at the height offset. Lamps on the area follow.
north_hint: North is needed for the sun (light through the windows).
roof_sections_hint: Each roof section covers a rectangle of the house, e.g. the house, the barn or an extension – each with its own shape, ridge direction, eave height and pitch. Drag in the plan to draw a new one; tap selects it, dragging moves it, the corners resize it.
roof_sections_start: Create roof sections from the rooms
roof_regen_confirm: Replace all roof sections with a new proposal from the rooms?
roof_section_hint: Heights count from the ground. A side with a lower eave reaches further down (catslide); pent roofs rise from the first side.
roof_on_floor_hint: Puts the section on this floor's wall tops; base and eaves move along. In the 3D view the roof belongs to this floor.
roof_base_hint: Below the ceiling height of the floor underneath, that floor's walls end under the roof: knee walls at the eaves, gables up to the ridge, inner walls cut by the slope. Dashed lines in the plan show where 1.5 m and 2 m of headroom remain.
roof_dormer_hint: A dormer on this side of the roof: 2 m wide, its front at the eave wall, eaves 1.4 m above the roof's eave, gable roof. Then move it and change its width and heights like any section; the main slope opens under it and the attic wall rises up to the dormer – a window fits there.
roof_outline_hint: A flat roof as a free shape: takes the outline of the shown floor's rooms (L- or Z-shaped too) as one surface without seams. The corners can be dragged afterwards.
roof_points_hint: Free shape: drag the corners in the plan. Back to the rectangle drops the shape.
roof_open_hint: For a terrace roof or a carport: posts and beams carry the roof instead of walls, and it is see-through. Where the canopy meets the house wall, it rests on the wall.
roof_swap_hint: Turns the roof round: the two sides swap eave and pitch, a pent roof rises the other way.
roof_ridge_short: Along the short side (e.g. terraced house)
gaps_hint: Join rooms up to 60 cm apart at one shared wall; the gap becomes the interior wall thickness.
straighten_hint: Finds room edges that are only a few centimetres off straight (a corner 1 cm out) and straightens them. Walls drawn slanted on purpose stay.
gaps_closed_wall: {n} places closed, interior wall now {t} m.
controls_side: Where the floor pictures, star, search and eye sit
keep_view_hint: Switching from floor to floor keeps the camera where it is – only its height follows.
hint_garage: Tap a wall to add a garage door
garage_hint: The door follows a garage cover (position or open/closed) or a garage door contact of the room's area.
door_hint: With a door contact the leaf swings open; without a sensor it stands half open.
hint_door: Tap a wall to add a door
hint_window: Tap a wall to add a window
terrain_hint: Where the ground lies around the house. What lies below it – a cellar, the lower part of a semi-basement – sits in the earth in 3D; lawns, paths and terraces lie on the ground.
terrain_earth_hint: Floors below the ground sit in the earth; open one and you see it as in a building pit. Off: they stand free as before.
terrain_cellar_hint: Semi-basement: lower the ground height as far as the cellar should show – e.g. −1.2 m. Cellar windows below the ground get a light well.
terrain_no_cellar_hint: A cellar is a floor with a negative elevation, e.g. −2.6 m.
well_hint: This window lies below the ground: in 3D it gets a light well with a grate. Untick for none – e.g. where a path runs past outside.
cellar_window_hint: Small and high up in the wall: 100 × 50 cm, 25 cm under the ceiling. Below the ground it gets a light well with a grate in 3D.
cover_position_invert: Sensor counts the other way round (0 = open)
tilt_angle_max: Angle that counts as fully tilted (°)
tilt_angle_invert: The angle counts the other way round
door_shut_hint: A door without a contact stands half open in 3D so it reads as a door. Ticked, it is drawn closed – front door, carport, side door.
contact_invert_hint: For sensors that report open and closed the other way round
opening_hint: Sensor type: window contact (reports open/closed), handle sensor (reports open, tilted and closed – e.g. a Homematic window handle) or contact + tilt sensor (a second sensor that only reports tilted). Automatic uses the blinds and contacts of the room's area. Position sensor: an entity reporting the blind's position while it moves (e.g. a Homematic "level", 0–100 % or 0–1, open = high) – the blind then moves live in 3D.
furniture_search_none: Nothing found. Try another word – English or German.
strip_upright_hint: The strip stands on end: its length runs up from the height above the floor – along a door frame, as a light column. The tilt lays a lying strip against a slope (90° = its face points sideways).
fridge_hint: While a door sensor reports open, the door swings open in 3D. The screen on the right door shows pictures by rules like a TV – while that door is closed.
stairwell_hint: A hole in this floor, for example above the staircase or for a gallery; from above you look through it. Across several rooms it is cut in each of them; several openings may overlap (for an L shape, for example). Stairs on the floor below that reach up here open the floor by themselves as well.
hint_wall: Drag to draw a single wall (partition, half wall) · Shift keeps it straight · Alt without snapping
wall_none_hint: Leave this wall out altogether: for open floor plans whose rooms are one space but separate in Home Assistant.
wall_thickness_hint: Thickness of this wall, e.g. 0.365 on a thick outer wall or 0.115 on a light partition. A wall between two rooms takes the thicker setting.
wall_thickness_reset: Thickness as set for the house
wall_split_hint: Split the wall here: the part gets a height of its own, e.g. 2.5 m next to 1.7 m in line
wall_join_hint: Remove the split point: the part joins the one before it again
room_wall_hint: A lower height turns the wall into a parapet or a counter. If two rooms share the wall, the lower setting applies. Windows and doors in it end at the wall height.
free_wall_hint: A free-standing wall, e.g. a partition. Where it meets a room wall, the corner is mitred. Drag the handles to move its ends, drag the line to move the whole wall.
wall_pos_hint: X and Y: the middle of the wall in the plan.
stairwell_outside: This opening lies in no room and is therefore not cut. Move it into a room.
hint_hole: Drag to draw a floor opening (stairwell, gallery)
hint_roof: Drag to draw a roof section · tap selects · drag moves · corners resize
hint_energy: Tap a solar field to select it · drag to move it, also onto another roof face · new fields with + Solar field on the right
parking_no_pack: No vehicle pack imported – vehicles come from the "Vehicles" pack (Furniture → Import furniture pack).
parking_hint: Without a sensor the vehicle always stands there. With one it appears as soon as the sensor reports "on", "home" or "present". A vehicle type sensor (e.g. from an AI camera analysis) picks the model: when its state matches a mapping – also as a word in the text – that vehicle is shown, otherwise the default one.
parking_too_tall: The vehicle ({car} m) is taller than the room ({room} m).
robot_hint: While the robot cleans in Home Assistant it drives lanes in 3D through the room it reports (a “current room” sensor, matched by room or area name), else through the room of its dock. The track is simulated – Home Assistant usually does not know the exact position. It drives back to the dock when it returns.
furn_color_entity_hint: For lights that a relay (Shelly, switch actuator) turns on and off while the bulb itself knows its colour and brightness: on/off comes from the switch above, colour and brightness from this entity.
lamp_hint: Tap the lamp in 3D to switch it, long press for the quick menu. Switches work too (e.g. a relay for the ceiling light) – the lamp shines while it is on. Table lamps stand on the furniture below them.
lamp_hint_pendant: Height = drop below the ceiling. Tap in 3D to switch, long press for details.
version_hint: Installed version of Casa 3D – the frontend; the integration in Home Assistant reports {backend}
accent_hint: An accent colour of your own: lines and glowing edges in the neon look, buttons and pins – ↺ brings the neon cyan back
side_fold_hint: Make the sidebar narrow – more room for the floor plan
side_pin_hint: Pinned, the sidebar stays open; otherwise it folds away beside the 3D view while nothing is selected
split_3d_hint: Live 3D next to the plan: drag and turn furniture and devices there – with undo, saved with the plan
furnish_hint: Drag furniture, lamps and devices · furniture snaps to walls · tap one to turn it, set its height and mount
heat_none_found: No matching sensors in the rooms' areas.
hh_appliance_hint: While it runs, its pin shows the time left; afterwards "Done!" until the door opens or it runs again.
hh_service_hint: E.g. a filter, salt or rinse aid: a binary sensor (on = due), a number (percent or days left) or a date. When it is due the item glows yellow and shows in "Today in the household".
hh_teaser_plant: With Household Pro the plant shows when it needs water.
hh_teaser_appliance: With Household Pro the appliance shows its time left and "Done!" until the door opens.
hh_teaser_fridge: With Household Pro Casa 3D warns when the fridge door stands open too long.
card_household_hint: Household Pro: glass card with bins, post, finished appliances, thirsty plants and service due
bin_match: Word in the calendar (empty: by its waste)
bin_hint: The bin glows from the set hour the day before until the hour on pickup day (for all bins); its pin says "Today" or "Tomorrow", a tap on the bin shows its next pickups. A calendar (e.g. from Waste Collection Schedule) is searched for the words of its waste; a sensor can give the days to the pickup or its date.
mailbox_hint: With a flag (e.g. an input_boolean "post" set by an automation) the mailbox glows while it is on. With a flap and an emptying door it glows when post came in after it was last emptied.
pro_feature_household: Household Pro: bins glow the evening before their pickup (waste calendar or sensor), the mailbox while post is in it, plants when thirsty; washer, dryer and dishwasher show their time left and "Done!"; filters and consumables due glow yellow; open fridge doors warn; glass card "Today in the household"; plus the smart fridge (side-by-side, doors with sensors)
household_teaser_bin: With Household Pro the bin glows the evening before its pickup – from your waste calendar.
household_teaser_mail: With Household Pro the mailbox glows as soon as post is in it – until it is emptied.
motor_invert_hint: For covers that report 100 % while the curtain is closed or the screen is down.
awning_invert_hint: For covers that report 100 % while the awning is in.
awning_kind_arm_hint: The classic over a terrace: folding arms push the fabric out with a slight fall. Depth = projection.
awning_kind_drop_hint: The arms swing out and down from the wall, the fabric stretches at a slant in front. Depth = arm length, fall = how far the arms go below the horizontal.
awning_kind_vertical_hint: The fabric runs straight down in side rails to the floor – in front of a window, a balcony railing or the front of a pergola. Height above the floor = the box's underside.
awning_kind_pergola_hint: A fixed frame with posts at the front; the fabric runs out on top of its rails. Depth = to the posts, fall = the roof's slope.
awning_kind_side_hint: A post with the rolled fabric on the left, the fabric pulls out sideways to the right up to the other post. Width = how far it pulls out, height above the floor = the fabric's height.
awning_hint: Width = the awning along the wall, depth = its projection fully out; the back of the frame goes against the house wall, height above the floor is the cassette's underside. If the cover reports its position while it runs, the awning runs out slowly in 3D; if it only says opening/closing, it moves along at the run time.
furn_only_color_hint: The lamp only glows while the light shows about this colour – e.g. yellow for "water" at the washbasin. The same light's other colours stay dark here.
furn_run_w_hint: From how many watts at the power sensor the appliance counts as running and glows (empty: 10 W). For appliances behind a smart plug that draw a few watts on standby, e.g. 100.
solar_pro_1: Modules that come alive in the sun and glow with their output
solar_pro_2: Fine power-flow lines through the house: where the power comes from and where it goes
solar_pro_3: A glass hologram with power, day curve, today's yield and self-sufficiency
solar_pro_4: Values per string on the roof, battery, wallbox and grid at a glance
solar_pro_free: Everything you set up here (fields, strings, devices, sensors) stays free and is used by the Pro add-on directly.
furn_export_hint: If your meter reports import and export in two sensors (e.g. Growatt, Tibber Pulse), take the import sensor as power above and the export sensor here. A signed sensor does not need this.
furn_charge_hint: If your battery reports charging and discharging in two sensors (e.g. Anker Solix), take the discharging sensor as power above and the charging sensor here. A signed sensor does not need this.
energy_only_note: ⚡ Energy: only solar fields and energy devices can be moved here; rooms and furniture are locked.
roof_only_note: 🏠 Roof: only roof sections and roof windows can be moved here; rooms and furniture are locked.
energy_devices_hint: Meter, inverters, home batteries, wallboxes and the grid connection are added here: on the floor chosen above, movable in the plan. With a power sensor they show their watts; the meter takes the grid sensor, a string picks its inverter. Several inverters and batteries (say a balcony plant on top) work too: each gets its own sensor.
solar_hint: Put modules on the roof: they lie in the slope of the roof face; on a flat roof they stand on frames. Drag a field in the plan to move it.
solar_no_roof: Solar fields need a roof: a gable or flat roof under Settings, or roof sections here in the Roof tool.
solar_partial: only {n} of {total} fit on the face
solar_form_hint: Modules that would reach beyond the roof face are left out. “Fill face” puts as many modules on the roof as fit. kWp counted with 400 W per module.
roof_windows_hint: Roof windows lie in the roof face, with a blind and contacts like windows. Drag them in the plan, also onto another roof face.
roof_window_float: Show over the room without the roof
roof_window_float_hint: When the roof fades out as you zoom in on a floor or a room, the window stays where it is over the room – open, tilted, with its blind. This works over rooms of the floor the roof sits on; where the slope reaches down over a lower floor, the windows stay in the roof. Off: it shows in the roof only.
roof_window_motor_hint: A window motor (Velux, Roto, Fakro) reports its position as a cover: the sash opens in 3D as far as the motor stands. A contact or tilt contact still works without a motor.
roof_window_hint: Open, the sash swings out, hinged at the top; tilted, a little; and the frame glows warm; the blind comes down over the glass from the top. In a roof section the window cuts a hole into the slope, so the attic looks out through it.
solar_tilt_wall: Tilt away from the wall (°, 90 = canopy)
solar_flip_wall: Standing off at the bottom instead of the top
inverter_strings_none: No string on this inverter yet – assign it at a solar field under String › Inverter.
solar_string_inverter_missing: No inverter in the plan yet (add one below under Devices)
solar_string_hint: Fields in the same string belong together, also on different roofs (e.g. 5 modules on the house and 5 on the garage). Sensor and inverter count for the whole string.
solar_face_size: Roof face {w} × {h} m (along the eave × up the slope)
solar_cols_hint: One number for rows of equal length, or a list for rows of their own: “4, 4, 3” (from the eave).
solar_pick_hint: Tap a module in the plan to take it away or put it back. Removed ones are dashed.
solar_entity: PV power of this field (e.g. its string)
grid_point_hint: Here the grid cable ends: at the handover point to the utility, e.g. at the end of the driveway. Movable in the plan; without a grid connection the cable ends at the edge of the outdoor areas.
furn_state_hint: The item glows while the entity reports on, occupied or home – a bed with an occupancy mat, an armchair, the sauna. Two entities light the halves: left and right, bottom and top for a bunk bed.
fix_hint: Fixed: cannot be moved by accident any more (key L, right-click or long press)
fixed_drag_hint: 🔒 Fixed – release it first to move it (lock in the form, right-click or key L)
fixed_delete_confirm: This item is fixed. Delete it anyway?
lock_plan_hint: Lock the floor plan: rooms, walls, doors, windows and outdoor areas cannot be moved by accident. Furniture and devices stay free.
start_view_hint: The 3D view, the card and the kiosk open the house with this view, e.g. from the garden side. Turn, zoom and move the house in the 3D pane on the right until it fits, then remember it.
start_view_card: If a card should open with a different view, put this line into its YAML configuration.
start_view_set: Remember the current 3D view as the start
start_view_saved: An own start view is saved.
climate_hint: These sensors count for the heatmap and the room panel. “Automatic” takes the sensors of the area and the ones placed in the room, but no device temperatures (3D printer, heat pump, flow …).
opening_mark_hint: A highlighted window or door glows warm. “When closed” needs a contact; without a sensor nothing is highlighted.
marker_show_hint: Automatic follows the None / Important / All switch of the 3D view. Always show and Hide apply regardless (except with None).
show_name: Show the name under the marker in 3D
card_marker_names_hint: Every device with an own name shows it small under its marker – three thermometers in the garden stay apart.
device_name_hint: A name for the plan only, e.g. "Island accent light" – the entity in Home Assistant stays as it is.
floor_shift_all_hint: Shift and turn act on every floor with the roof sections, outdoor areas, cables, meter and hologram – the whole house moves as one.
floor_turn_hint: Turns everything on the floor by 90° clockwise about the middle of its rooms – when a floor was drawn the wrong way round. Three times = 270°.
marker_icon_hint: The name of a Material Design icon as in Home Assistant, e.g. mdi:thermometer or mdi:water-alert. Empty = the symbol of the device kind.
furn_holo_hint: A glass card over the device with its power now, today's consumption and the day curve – in the house and the floor view. Needs a power sensor.
furn_links_hint: With a power sensor the item shows its watts and gets an energy cable.
screen_pictures_hint: The state or an attribute of the entity is compared (e.g. a TV's app_name). A value matches when it is equal or contained in the text ("youtube" matches "com.google.android.youtube.tv"); "*" = always. The first matching rule wins. Pictures are stored scaled to 512 px; a picture URL or a camera works too – a camera's live picture is refreshed every 5 seconds while shown. Without a matching rule the screen shows the media player.
picture_attribute: Compare the state or an attribute
furn_links_hint_tv: The screen glows while the TV is on, in the colour of the app (Netflix, YouTube …); the label shows the app or title.
stairs_hint: The stair rises towards the back (away from the marked front edge) and opens the ceiling of the floor above.
stairs_u_hint: The U-stair rises from the marked front edge towards the back, turns at the landing and comes back up on the other side. “Mirror” turns it the other way. It opens the ceiling of the floor above.
energy_meters_hint: Energy Pro: the house card shows how much gas and water were used today – from the meters' statistics (a counter, e.g. in m³). "Take over from the energy dashboard" fills both too.
energy_hint: Consumers are placed devices with a power sensor (W) – the sensor itself or one of the same device.
energy_balance_hint: Grid, solar and battery come from the devices in the plan: meter, inverter and home battery. Here you can choose other sensors, flip signs and set the house consumption.
energy_consumption_sensor: House consumption (W, else from the balance)
energy_import_prefs: Take over from the energy dashboard
energy_import_done: {n} sensors taken over – please check the signs.
energy_import_none: No matching power sensors (W) were found in the energy dashboard – please choose them by hand.
energy_import_failed: Home Assistant's energy dashboard is not set up.
hint_meter: Tap the spot of the meter
presence_hint: Room sensor per person (e.g. ESPresense, Bermuda): its state names the room or area.
no_persons: There are no people in Home Assistant.
